Spott is a Software Development company. Spott is an AI-native ATS and CRM platform for recruitment and staffing firms to manage candidates, automate workflows, and close placements faster. Spott employs 46 people (+283.3% YoY, +34 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with presence in Belgium and Australia.
